description: Essential for building and maintaining applications. Full-stack developers work on both the front-end and back-end of applications. Front-end developers focus on the user interface and user experience, while back-end developers work on the server-side logic and databases.
questions: "Can you describe a project where you utilized both front-end and back-end technologies and what was your role in it?"
"What are some of the programming languages you are comfortable with and can you discuss a project where you used them?"
"Can you explain your understanding of the MVC design pattern and provide an example of its use in one of your projects?"
"How do you approach debugging when you encounter an issue in your code?"
"Can you discuss your experience with version control systems such as Git?"
